items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Ike Carpenter was on the band. Ike Carpenter played piano on that V disc, on your music.

ctx.x: How long did you play your second time on the band?

We were in San Francisco a few months and then we came down to Hollywood. I stayed with the band except for the times they would go out on tour. When they left town to go on tour, even to another location, out of town, I wouldn't leave town. I'd stay and they would use someone else, Ike or Dodo or Joe--what's his
name, a terrific pianist that everybody gave up on because he was so sick and just recently he returned to New York and I hear he's playing the greatest, he's not sick--Joe Albany. That was his name.
